name: Local Model Gateway
purpose: A common interface for local and frontier agents to run local models on this machine. MVP runs local LLMs (GGUF text) through the built llama.cpp llama-server, selected from a declarative registry (models.json) by model id or tier alias. The registry also declares STT/TTS/embedding models (staged, but wired in their own later modules). First stochastic/mixed skill: records full model_provenance and a generation-completeness confidence. Governor Phase 3 Stage-1.1 (D-0067): the named warm POOL MANAGER (mechanism C) is HARDENED so it can be enabled by default. Integrity core (lib/PoolManager.psm1, unit-tested): reuse vs reload is decided by CanServe(resident,request) -- exact on semantic identity, '>=' on capacity (a 32K/9B resident serves a 16K/M0 request); a deterministic resident_config_hash (hashes model+engine-exe CONTENTS, not paths) is split from a per-launch instance_generation nonce; residency is a crash-atomic state machine EMPTY->STOPPING->EMPTY_CONFIRMED->STARTING->RESIDENT (atomic replace) reconciled on every startup under a machine-global lock; a monotonic fence + short renewable TTL is the authority, and an inference call carrying -ExpectGeneration/-ExpectFence is REJECTED on mismatch (no wrong-generation call lands); the resident is proven by the listening SOCKET OWNER (not a /v1/models alias); -PrepareGpu evicts-before-grant for a GPU handoff (no blind co-load); LRU + the timed idle-unload are removed from the correctness path and same-model prefix reuse is dropped (KV isolation = erase-on-checkout/check-in). The pool is an OPTIONAL layer (-BypassPoolManager forces the classic cold isolated-server path); integrity invariants are non-bypassable. Default OFF -> the classic per-call + D-0057 warm paths are byte-for-byte unchanged. Stage-1.1 residual (a) durable finding 5: a companion DURABLE gateway supervisor (Start-GatewaySupervisor.ps1 + lib/Supervisor.psm1) is the PERSISTENT process that owns the resident llama-server tree in a Windows Job Object (JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, P/Invoke) so residency + tree ownership SURVIVE across per-call invocations; per-call gateways ATTACH over a file-protocol control channel (runtime/supervisor/control/) and reuse the resident (~1 ms, no respawn) via -UseSupervisor, degrading to the per-call path if no supervisor is live. The supervisor is the single owner running the PoolManager transitions; the Job Object reaps the whole tree if the supervisor dies; on restart it reconciles the published manifest as a claim to VERIFY. Pool STILL DEFAULT-OFF this wave (enable-by-default awaits a soak + the res.lease fencing wave, findings 13/14). v0.5.0 (i21, the R1b CONSUMER wave) adds the DEFAULT-OFF GPU-lease-split adoption of res.lease 0.4.x (-UsePoolLeaseSplit): a revocable residency_pin held BETWEEN calls (priority = tier), a plain short exec re-attach around a same-model reuse, every swap/load through the v0.4 TWO-PHASE transition (-Transition -TwoPhaseCommit -> non-usable capability -> start -> '-Action commit -HealthOk' AFTER health; -HealthFailed drops the exact tentative instance and leaves the GPU EMPTY) driving the REAL supervisor-routed nvidia-smi evictor lib/PoolEvictor.ps1 (-EvictorMode command; every destructive step names the exact resident_instance_id and consults '-Action fence-op' first; NEVER a PID kill), the FULL v0.4 tuple (owner_id + owner_incarnation_id + gpu_authority_epoch + resident_generation + resident_instance_id + exec_lease_id) asserted BEFORE and re-asserted AFTER every completion (a stale in-flight result is DISCARDED), and a supervisor-side TARGET-FENCED evict (a targeted stop must name the manifest's exact resident_instance_id). OFF == the classic + D-0057 warm + Stage-1.1 pool + supervisor paths byte-for-byte. v0.6.0 (i23, the SUPERVISOR-HARDENING wave) folds the i21 frontier red-team's 10 must-fixes into the DEFAULT-OFF durable supervisor + integrity layer + real evictor (additive; every default path byte-for-byte unchanged): PER-RESIDENT SUSPENDED-CREATE JOB CUSTODY (CreateProcess CREATE_SUSPENDED -> AssignProcessToJobObject -> IsProcessInJob verify -> ResumeThread; the supervisor holds each per-resident KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE handle; NO child runs before it is in its job; job-assignment failure is FATAL on the Windows path -- no uncustodied publish; tree_gone = per-resident Job zero-members); a LIFETIME SUPERVISOR SINGLETON (named mutex, a second supervisor exits); AUTHENTICATED IPC (strict request_id + path containment, idempotent replay guard, generation binding, a separate authenticated admin shutdown); NO launch after a failed/partial evict or a failed CAS (fail-closed, GPU left ungranted, manifest not cleared); an ABANDONMENT-AWARE pool lock with a nonce'd release (no time-bound steal of a live owner); HARD nvidia-smi probe deadlines (pinned absolute path, kill-on-timeout -> unknown -> confirmed:false) + unmanaged_vram_pressure (never a blind kill); HEARTBEAT-STALE => UNRESPONSIVE with NO live-but-unresponsive fallback (the client fails closed instead of spawning a split-brain second server); RESTART reconcile that never adopts a manifest-only survivor (adopt only via a retained custodian); and REAL pre-launch content verification (sha256 vs a trusted expected-hash manifest, reparse-point rejection). Residuals (named): the grown soak, the in-proc res.lease client, the exec.watchdog #00.1 supervisor-relaunch driver, and the ACL'd app-data state relocation + trusted-hash provisioning.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Model <model_id> | -Tier <tiny|weak|mid|strong>; -Prompt <s> [-System <s>]; sampling -MaxTokens -Temperature -TopP -TopK -Seed [-Stop <s[]>]; -Registry <models.json> -Port <int> -GpuLayers <int> -Context <int> -LoadTimeoutSec <int> -ReviewQueuePath <path>. GPU lease (res.lease #29): -GpuLease <off|auto|wait|require> -GpuLeaseWaitSeconds <int> -GpuLeaseTtlSeconds <int> -GpuLeaseHolder <id> -LeaseDir <dir> -ResLeasePath <path> -PwshPath <path>. Governor Phase 2 warm server: -Warm (keep a resident llama-server across calls, detached so it outlives the launching task) -EvictWarm (clean stop) -WarmRegistryPath <path>. Governor Phase 3 Stage-1 pool manager: -EnsureResident (make the requested model resident under the expanded residency key, then return; no generation) -PoolStatus (read-only resident report) -SweepIdle (evict a resident idle beyond -KeepResidentSeconds, default 90) -CacheTypeK/-CacheTypeV <f16|q8_0|...> -FlashAttn -Parallel <int, -np> -IdSlot <int> -ClearSlot -KeepResidentSeconds <int> -Generation <int, force a swap>. OR -InputsJson '<json {model,tier,prompt,system,messages,max_tokens,temperature,top_p,top_k,seed,stop,registry,port,gpu_layers,context,load_timeout_s,review_queue_path,gpu_lease,gpu_lease_wait_s,gpu_lease_ttl_s,gpu_lease_holder,lease_dir,res_lease_path,pwsh_path,warm,evict_warm,warm_registry_path,ensure_resident,pool_status,sweep_idle,cache_type_k,cache_type_v,flash_attn,parallel,id_slot,clear_slot,keep_resident_s,generation}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId. i21 GPU-lease split (default-OFF): -UsePoolLeaseSplit -SplitPriority <int> -OwnerIncarnationId <id> -SplitRequiredVramMib <int> -SplitExecTtlSeconds <int> -SplitPinTtlSeconds <int> -SplitDrainTimeoutMs <int> (InputsJson keys use_pool_lease_split, split_priority, owner_incarnation_id, split_required_vram_mib, split_exec_ttl_s, split_pin_ttl_s, split_drain_timeout_ms).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Explicit registry model_id (e.g. llm.weak.qwen2p5-1p5b). Highest precedence.

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: LLM tier alias mapped by the registry: tiny|weak|mid|strong. Used when model is omitted.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: User prompt (required unless messages[] is supplied via InputsJson).

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: Optional system message prepended to a prompt.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: Optional [{role,content}] chat array (overrides system+prompt). InputsJson only.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Max tokens to generate.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: Sampling temperature.

inputs.name: top_p
inputs.description: Top-p nucleus sampling.

inputs.name: top_k
inputs.description: Top-k sampling.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed (-1 = random).

inputs.name: stop
inputs.description: Optional stop strings.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Path to models.json (default: the skill's own models.json).

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: Loopback port for llama-server (default: auto-pick a free port from 8140).

inputs.name: gpu_layers
inputs.description: Override the registry's gpu_layers for this run.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Override the registry's context window for this run.

inputs.name: load_timeout_s
inputs.description: Max seconds to wait for the server to become healthy.

inputs.name: gpu_lease
inputs.description: GPU-lease mode (res.lease #29): off | auto (non-blocking, log+proceed if contended) | wait (block up to gpu_lease_wait_s, then proceed) | require (error if it cannot acquire). Acquired before llama-server starts, released after teardown. Absent res.lease -> graceful proceed.

inputs.name: gpu_lease_wait_s
inputs.description: Blocking wait budget for gpu_lease wait|require (auto forces 0).

inputs.name: gpu_lease_ttl_s
inputs.description: Lease TTL seconds.

inputs.name: gpu_lease_holder
inputs.description: Stable holder id; default $env:LIFEORCH_INSTANCE else model.gateway:<pid>.

inputs.name: lease_dir
inputs.description: Shared lease dir passthrough to res.lease (all coordinating processes must resolve the same dir).

inputs.name: res_lease_path
inputs.description: Override path to Invoke-ResLease.ps1 (default: auto-resolve via repo root / sibling module).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh used to spawn res.lease as a child process (default: resolve via PATH).

inputs.name: warm
inputs.description: Governor Phase 2: keep the llama-server RESIDENT across separate gateway invocations (registry runtime/warm-server.json). Reuse when the model is unchanged; evict+reload on a model change. On Windows the server is launched detached via Win32_Process.Create so it OUTLIVES the launching task/Job (a Start-Process child dies on task completion); the call returns immediately, never blocking on the server. PID-tracked + killable (never orphaned). The gpu lease stays per-call. Default off = classic per-call spawn/kill.

inputs.name: evict_warm
inputs.description: Tear down the resident warm server and return immediately (action=evict_warm, no model load, no generation) -- the clean explicit stop; leaves 0 orphaned llama-server.

inputs.name: warm_registry_path
inputs.description: Override the resident-server registry path (default: runtime/warm-server.json).

inputs.name: ensure_resident
inputs.description: Pool manager (Stage-1): make the requested model resident under the EXPANDED residency key, confirm /health + provenance, publish the residency manifest, then RETURN without generating (Ensure-ResidentModel). Forces warm. Reuse ~1 ms on an exact key match; else evict (confirm process exit + VRAM recovery) + reload.

inputs.name: pool_status
inputs.description: Read-only: report the current resident (pid/model/residency_key_sha/idle_ms/swap_count/health). Takes no lease and makes no change.

inputs.name: sweep_idle
inputs.description: Evict the resident IFF it is idle beyond keep_resident_s (a higher-priority contender or another module GPU request reclaims the card); else keep. Confirms process exit + VRAM recovery.

inputs.name: cache_type_k
inputs.description: KV key-cache type (residency-key field). f16 default per D-0063; q8_0 only after an S0 re-pass.

inputs.name: cache_type_v
inputs.description: KV value-cache type (residency-key field).

inputs.name: flash_attn
inputs.description: Enable flash-attention (residency-key field).

inputs.name: parallel
inputs.description: llama-server slot count (-np). Stage-1 pins 1 for deterministic same-model prefix reuse (residency-key field).

inputs.name: id_slot
inputs.description: DEPRECATED (Stage-1.1): same-model prefix reuse is dropped from the correctness path; the pool erases the single slot on checkout AND check-in for KV isolation. Retained for back-compat; no longer pins a reuse slot.

inputs.name: clear_slot
inputs.description: DEPRECATED (Stage-1.1): slot erase is now unconditional in pool mode (erase-on-checkout/check-in), so this flag is a no-op.

inputs.name: keep_resident_s
inputs.description: Idle keep-resident window; SweepIdle (a POLICY op, not autonomous) evicts a resident idle beyond this after RE-READING under the machine-global lock. Refreshed on same-model reuse.

inputs.name: generation
inputs.description: DEPRECATED (finding 6): no longer poisons the config hash. If >=0 it FORCES an evict+reload (use -force_reload instead).

inputs.name: force_reload
inputs.description: Stage-1.1: integrity-neutral force of an evict+reload even when the resident CanServe the request.

inputs.name: expect_generation
inputs.description: Stage-1.1 (finding 1): reject the inference call unless the LIVE resident's instance_generation matches (no wrong-generation call lands).

inputs.name: expect_fence
inputs.description: Stage-1.1 (finding 1): reject the inference call unless the resident's fence matches (-1 = do not check).

inputs.name: fence_ttl_s
inputs.description: Stage-1.1 (finding 1): short renewable fence TTL seconds (~90-120), NOT 1800; renewed within a whole-task hold.

inputs.name: prepare_gpu
inputs.description: Stage-1.1 (finding 2): AcquirePreparedGpu -- evict the resident before granting so a handoff to another GPU consumer never OOMs (no blind co-load). Confirms VRAM recovery over an async interval.

inputs.name: required_vram_mib
inputs.description: VRAM (MiB) the other consumer needs; PrepareGpu evicts the resident if free headroom is short.

inputs.name: vram_safety_mib
inputs.description: Target-headroom margin over required_vram_mib (finding 15).

inputs.name: vram_confirm_timeout_ms
inputs.description: WDDM frees VRAM async -- confirm recovery over this interval, not a single sample (finding 15).

inputs.name: reconcile
inputs.description: Stage-1.1 (finding 3): run crash-recovery reconcile (also runs implicitly on every pool op) under the machine-global lock and return a report.

inputs.name: bypass_pool_manager
inputs.description: Framing: legacy escape -- force the classic cold isolated-server path even under -Warm. Integrity invariants stay non-bypassable.

inputs.name: use_supervisor
inputs.description: Residual (a) durable finding 5: route residency ops (ensure_resident/pool_status/prepare_gpu/evict_warm/reconcile) to a RUNNING persistent supervisor (Start-GatewaySupervisor.ps1) so the resident + its Job-Object tree ownership survive ACROSS per-call invocations; a fresh gateway ATTACHES and reuses (~1 ms, no respawn). Degrades (with a warning) to the per-call path if no supervisor is live. Inference is NOT routed -- it reuses the supervisor-published resident via the classic warm path (same warm-server.json). Default off -> classic behaviour unchanged.

inputs.name: supervisor_root
inputs.description: Supervisor control-dir root (default: runtime/supervisor); must match the value Start-GatewaySupervisor.ps1 was started with.

inputs.name: use_pool_lease_split
inputs.description: i21 R1b consumer adoption (DEFAULT-OFF; off == byte-for-byte). Engage the res.lease 0.4.x GPU-lease split on the pool paths (-Warm/-EnsureResident): residency_pin between calls, exec around ops, every swap/load through the two-phase transition + lib/PoolEvictor.ps1, the full v0.4 tuple asserted per call, a stale in-flight result DISCARDED.

inputs.name: split_priority
inputs.description: Residency-pin priority (0 = derive from the tier: tiny 10 / weak 20 / mid 30 / strong 40). A strictly-higher-priority contender revokes a lower-priority pin via the transition (finding 13).

inputs.name: owner_incarnation_id
inputs.description: v0.4 ABA identity minted per owning-process RESTART. Default: $env:LIFEORCH_OWNER_INCARNATION (the governor sets one per run), else adopted from the live pin on re-attach (same owner, same incarnation), else minted per invocation.

inputs.name: split_required_vram_mib
inputs.description: Transition required_vram_mib = the measured PEAK for the config (weights + KV + compute + overhead + margin), NOT the GGUF size. 0 = derive size_mib + max(512, 10%).

inputs.name: split_exec_ttl_s
inputs.description: TTL of the short exec/transition lease held only across load/evict/generate.

inputs.name: split_pin_ttl_s
inputs.description: TTL of the between-calls residency pin (re-attach renews it each call).

inputs.name: split_drain_timeout_ms
inputs.description: Bounded cooperative drain of an ACTIVE inference before cancel -> supervisor Job-Object tree-kill (in-flight revocation).

outputs.description: Generation: { model, engine, mode, selected_from, request{messages,sampling}, output{role,text}, generation{finish_reason,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,total_tokens,timings}, server{port,health_ms,gpu_layers,context,gpu_lease{...},warm{enabled,reused,started_new,evicted,load_ms,registry_path[,pool{action,residency_key_sha,swap_count,idle_ms_at_entry,keep_resident_seconds,id_slot,cache_type_k,cache_type_v,flash_attn,parallel,provenance,vram}]}} } (the warm.pool block is present only on a warm/pool call). A -EnsureResident call returns mode:'ensure_resident' with pool{action(reuse|evict_reload|cold_start),reused,started_new,evicted,evict_confirmed,residency_key,residency_key_sha,swap_count,keep_resident_seconds,idle_ms_at_entry,resident_since_utc,load_ms,health_ok,provenance{ok,source,reported},vram{free_mib_before,free_mib_after,recovered_mib}} and no generation output. -PoolStatus returns { action:'pool_status', pool{registry_path,has_resident,resident_pid,model_id,residency_key_sha,alive,identity_ok,healthy,idle_ms,keep_resident_seconds,idle_expired,swap_count,resident_since_utc,last_used_utc} }. -SweepIdle returns { action:'sweep_idle', pool{had_resident,idle_ms,keep_resident_seconds,evicted,kept,reason,resident_pid,vram_free_mib_before,vram_free_mib_after,vram_recovered_mib} }. A -EvictWarm call returns { action:'evict_warm', warm{...} }.

models: a GGUF LLM declared in models.json
